messages:
vivian: opened PR 560 to tidy up console/observability quickstarts. ran into three small issues during preview: 1) the Kotlin SDK tracehook example is missing, 2) cost field appears as `token_usd_per_token` in one example but `token_cost_usd` elsewhere, and 3) the interactive embed for the cost-simulator returns 404 in staging. can we divvy up?
chris: i can add the Kotlin snippet. want it idiomatic coroutine style or a super small sync example? keep it <10 lines.
vivian: keep it tiny and coroutine-friendly is fine, just show creating a TraceHook, attaching a trace id, and setting token cost + latency tags. also add a one-line note about units.
kai: i'll normalize the field name. prefer `token_cost_usd` as canonical. i'll run a repo grep and a docs-lint rule to catch the old variant.
docs-bot: PR 560 opened by vivian ' reviewers: @kai @chris. CI: docs-link-check queued.
chris: Kotlin draft (coroutine-style): ```kotlin
import com.redwood.trace.TraceHook

val hook = TraceHook("console-playground")
hook.attachContext(mapOf("trace_id" to traceId))
hook.setTag("token_cost_usd", 0.0028)
hook.setTag("latency_ms", 105)
```
vivian: nice and compact. add link to Kotlin SDK reference under "SDK snippets" header.
kai: running link-check in staging now. also adding linter to fail CI if `token_usd_per_token` shows up. will include a short migration snippet (jq one-liner) in PR body.
docs-bot: docs-link-check result: embed /interactive/cost-sim -> 404. creating infra ticket 511.
infra-bot: infra#511 created and assigned to @dave-infra. note: route removed during last router cleanup.
vivian: plan: chris adds Kotlin snippet + reference link, kai renames keys and adds linter + migration note, infra investigates route or we add a static fallback image for the embed. target: merge once either route is back or fallback present. thanks folks. /end of thread
